summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MedMatch authentication system including Apple Sign In integration. All backend endpoints working correctly. Frontend UI displays Google and Apple Sign In buttons properly. Apple Sign In redirects to Apple's authorization page but shows 'invalid_client' error - this is an Apple Developer Console configuration issue, not a code issue.
passed_tests: ✅ Backend: /api/auth/apple/config returns valid configuration (client_id, scope, response_mode, response_type)
✅ Backend: /api/auth/apple/callback rejects invalid tokens with 401
✅ Backend: /api/auth/apple/callback requires id_token field (422 on missing)
✅ Backend: /api/auth/google/session requires session_id (400 on missing)
✅ Backend: /api/auth/google/session rejects invalid session (401)
✅ Backend: /api/auth/login works with admin credentials (admin@medmatch.com/MedMatch2026!)
✅ Backend: /api/auth/login rejects invalid credentials (401)
✅ Backend: /api/auth/register creates new user with trial membership
✅ Backend: /api/auth/register gives recruiters free active membership
✅ Backend: /api/auth/register rejects duplicate email (400)
✅ Backend: /api/auth/me requires authentication (401 without token)
✅ Backend: /api/auth/me returns user info with valid token
✅ Backend: /api/auth/logout works correctly
✅ Backend: /api/auth/logout invalidates session
✅ Frontend: Login page loads with Google and Apple Sign In buttons
✅ Frontend: Google Sign In button visible and enabled
✅ Frontend: Apple Sign In button visible and enabled (black button with Apple logo)
✅ Frontend: Email/Password form visible with proper inputs
✅ Frontend: Registration form shows role selection (Job Seeker/Recruiter)
✅ Frontend: Job Seeker shows '$1 lifetime • 15-day trial' text
✅ Frontend: Recruiter shows 'Free forever' text
✅ Frontend: Email login flow works - redirects to dashboard after login
✅ Frontend: Google Sign In redirects to Emergent Auth (auth.emergentagent.com)
✅ Frontend: Apple Sign In redirects to Apple authorization page (appleid.apple.com)

apple_signin_status.backend_callback: WORKING - Properly validates tokens and handles errors
apple_signin_status.frontend_button: WORKING - Displays correctly and redirects to Apple
apple_signin_status.apple_authorization: CONFIGURATION NEEDED - Apple shows 'invalid_client' error. The Services ID (com.medmatch.signin.web) and redirect URL (https://hirelifesci.preview.emergentagent.com/login) need to be registered in Apple Developer Console

action_items: APPLE DEVELOPER CONSOLE: Register the redirect URL 'https://hirelifesci.preview.emergentagent.com/login' in Apple Developer Console under Services IDs > com.medmatch.signin.web > Website URLs
APPLE DEVELOPER CONSOLE: Verify the Services ID 'com.medmatch.signin.web' is properly configured with Sign In with Apple capability
critical_code_review_comments: Apple Sign In backend implementation is complete and correct - uses proper JWT verification with fallback
Frontend correctly handles Apple callback via URL hash fragment (response_mode=fragment)
All authentication endpoints properly return user role, membership_status, and trial_ends_at fields
seed_data_creation: Created test users during pytest execution (TEST_register_*, TEST_recruiter_*, TEST_dup_*)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Apple Sign In integration is code-complete. Backend endpoints (/api/auth/apple/config and /api/auth/apple/callback) are working. Frontend button redirects to Apple correctly. The 'invalid_client' error from Apple is a configuration issue - the Services ID and redirect URL need to be registered in Apple Developer Console. Google Sign In via Emergent Auth is working. Email login/register is working. All auth endpoints return proper user data including role and membership status.
